In detail

An affluent, mostly residential hill district on the Buda side. It does not appear in any theft, burglary, violent-crime, or nightlife-disorder hotspot list checked for this build, consistent with its long-standing reputation as one of Budapest's quieter, more expensive residential areas. Sources checked: BPhirek.hu, 1 Jun 2023 (district-by-district crime comparison, no negative naming for District II).
